_decision: onDarkHover = oklch(0.922 0 0). the icon colour inside a hovered rail button. The value comes from proposedDarkRailTokens — the approved decision record — NOT from measuring the component and writing down what it happened to say. If this check fails, that is the finding.
_serialisation: The expected string is the COMPUTED spelling. tokens.css authors some colours as oklch(55.6% 0 0) while the browser computes oklch(0.556 0 0) — the same colour, and compare() is exact string equality. proposedDarkRailTokens already uses the computed spelling, so the value is copied unchanged. Never resolve a mismatch by pasting the measured value.
_scope: Anchored to the ICON, not the button, because the button already carries a background token's anchor and an element holds exactly one. `color` inherits, so the icon is a truthful subject for the foreground token.
